tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) worm, scarlet stuff, crimson
1a) worm-the female 'coccus ilicis'
1b) scarlet stuff, crimson, scarlet
1b1) the dye made from the dried body of the female of the worm "coccus ilicis"
Also means: to.le.ah (תּוֹלֵעָה "worm" H8438B)

1) worm, maggot
1a) worm, grub
1b) the worm "coccus ilicis"

strongs_1890.strongs_def: the crimson-grub, but used only (in this connection) of the colorfrom it, and cloths dyed therewith
strongs_1890.derivation: and (feminine) תּוֹלֵעָה; or תּוֹלַעַת; or תֹּלַעַת; from H3216 (יָלַע); a maggot (as voracious); specifically (often with ellipsis of H8144 (שָׁנִי))
